This plot is small, only 0.12 hectares, and it is rented so I do not want to spend too much money on it. It is my perennial plot — maybe some coffee or fruit trees and maybe some enset — so I do not need new seed every year. I cannot read or write and I have no money for chemical fertilizer or pesticide, so I will use the manure from my animals and do the work myself with my family. There is no irrigation here, we depend on the meher rains.
